name: Classic Mac
extraCss: .window{border:2px solid #000;box-shadow:none;padding:2px}.titlebar{border:1px solid #000;justify-content:center;position:relative;padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px}.title{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:calc(100% - 58px);background:#fff;padding:1px 10px;flex:0 1 auto;text-align:center;z-index:1}.icon{display:none}.controls{position:absolute;left:2px;top:2px;margin:0;order:0;z-index:2}.minimize,.maximize{display:none}.caption.close{width:16px;height:16px;background:#fff;box-shadow:none;border:2px solid #000}.menubar{border-bottom:1px solid #000;background:#fff}.menubtn:hover,.menubtn.open{border-color:#000;background:#000;color:#fff}.menu{border:2px solid #000;box-shadow:none;background:#fff}.editorframe{border:1px solid #000;box-shadow:none;padding:1px}.status{border:1px solid #000;box-shadow:none}.aboutbox{border:2px solid #000;box-shadow:none}.abouttitle{border-bottom:1px solid #000;justify-content:center;position:relative;padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px}.abouttitle span{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:calc(100% - 58px);background:#fff;padding:1px 10px;flex:0 1 auto;text-align:center;z-index:1}.abouttitle .caption{position:absolute;left:2px;top:2px;z-index:2}.winbutton{background:#fff;border:2px solid #000;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fff,inset 0 0 0 3px #000}
